title: Xiaohongshu carousel
blurb: Four scenes around your product, each a 3:4 page, ready to post as one 小红书 note.

inputs.label: Product photo
inputs.help: Any clear photo of the product on its own.

prompt: Place this product on a white marble counter in soft morning light, with a folded towel and a small plant. Keep the product exactly as it is.
Place this product on a teak side table by a window, warm sunlight and soft shadows. Keep the product exactly as it is.
Place this product among green plants in dappled sunlight, fresh and natural. Keep the product exactly as it is.
Show this product held in a hand, close up, in natural daylight. Keep the product exactly as it is.
